newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares rise slightly in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares rise slightly in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares rose slightly on Thursday on the Beirut Secondary Market (BSM) after bigger gains during the past few days.

A shares rose to $115.25 from Wednesday's $115 on the privately-operated BSM and B shares rose to $117.250 from $117.125. Both shares have been gaining in value since last Monday, with rises of more than two percent daily before Thursday's close.

Dealers say momentum had been building up on the Beirut equities market because of expectations that SOLIDERE will launch a $150 million GDR issue in mid-October, giving non-Arab investors access to the market for the first time.
SOLIDERE declined to comment on the report which followed rumours on the Beirut market.
Turnover on the BSM, which trades only SOLIDERE shares, rose slightly to 15,460 shares from 15,246 on Wednesday and value was $1,793,646.75 from $1,767,433.
On the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE), there was no trade in any of the four listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit ETR.BY and Uniceramic.
On Wednesday, 1,500 Ciments Libanais shares were traded at $1.375.
The BLOM index rose 0.15 percent to 999.02. The LISPI index rose 0.05 percent to 85.63. They cover both markets.
